contest.text:
The Tribal Chief presides ceremonially over the Secret City's festival.
The contestants propose repairs near the city's monumental works. One uses an unfamiliar arch whose stones seem ready to fall upward. The stern stonewright demands proof. A controlled load test vindicates the builder, or exposes a hidden support that must be disclosed before judging.
